s.note: Cabbie has been driving that island for years
s.how: Tip 150g beef jerky and 200g honey-roasted peanuts into a big paper bag. Add 4 dried chillies broken in half for a bit of heat, close the top and shake well. Serve straight from the bag.

s.note: eating out of tins in a city with no shops
s.how: Drain 2 tins sardines in oil, about 220g. Lay a sardine on each of 24 saltine crackers, squeeze over lemon, add a drop of hot sauce and a little chopped parsley. Serve on the tin lids for the full survival look.

m.note: whatever the Duke's crew could find on the island
m.how: Brown 500g sliced smoked sausage in a big pot. Add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 600g diced potatoes, cook 5 minutes, then 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 can cannellini beans, 400g crushed tomatoes and 750ml chicken stock. Simmer 30 minutes, add a quarter cabbage shredded for the last 10, season and serve in mugs.

w.how: Melt 150g butter with 3 tbsp golden syrup and 100g brown sugar, then stir in 250g rolled oats. Press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Cool, spread with 100g melted dark chocolate and cut into 12 bars once set.

d.how: Brew 1 litre of drip coffee with 60g ground coffee. Pour black into four steel mugs and keep the pot hot on the stove for refills through the night.
